source: City of San Ramon Zoning Ordinance Division D-2 (https://cdnsm5-hosted.civiclive.com/UserFiles/Servers/Server_10826046/File/Our%20City/Departments/Community%20Development/Planning/Zoning%20Ordinance/Division%20D-2%2002.28.20.pdf); San Ramon Municipal Code Title D (https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/sanramon-ca/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=3764); Zoning Ordinance page (https://www.sanramon.ca.gov/our_city/departments_and_divisions/community_development/planning_services/zoning_ordinance)

RA.description: Rural Agricultural Zone. Large-lot rural residential and agriculture. Up to 0.5 du/net ac.

RL.description: Residential Low Density Zone. Single-family detached homes on large lots. 0.5-3.0 du/net ac.

RS.description: Single Family Residential Zone. Standard single-family neighborhoods. 3.0-6.0 du/net ac (typical 3-6 du/ac).

RM.description: Multiple Family Medium Density Zone. Townhomes, duplexes, small apartments. 6-14 du/net ac.

RMH.description: Medium-High Density Residential Zone. Apartments, condominiums. 14-22 du/net ac.

RH.description: Multiple Family High Density Zone. Apartments, condominiums. 22-30 du/net ac.

RVH.description: Multiple Family Very High Density Zone. Intensive multifamily residential. 30-50 du/net ac.

MU.description: Mixed Use Zone. Integrated mix of residential and non-residential uses. 14-30 du/ac; up to 0.70 FAR non-residential.

CCMU.description: City Center Mixed Use Zone. High-density mixed-use in City Center. 22-50 du/ac; up to 0.70 FAR (1.35 max with public benefits).

MU-C.description: Commercial Mixed Use Zone. Integrated non-residential uses only (retail, services, offices). No residential. Up to 0.70 FAR.

CN.description: Neighborhood Commercial Zone. Small-scale convenience commercial serving adjacent neighborhoods.

CR.description: Commercial Recreation Zone. Recreational commercial uses. Up to 0.35 FAR.

CO.description: Commercial Office Zone. Office, professional, and administrative uses.

MW.description: Manufacturing/Warehousing Zone. General and low-intensity industrial, manufacturing, distribution, R&D. Up to 0.50 FAR.

OS.description: Open Space Zone. Parks, recreation, resource conservation, and open space preservation.

PF.description: Public Facility Zone. Government buildings, schools, utilities, and other public facilities.

AG.description: Agricultural Zone. Agricultural uses with very limited residential.

CC.description: Community Commercial Zone. Community-scale retail and commercial uses.

CT.description: Commercial Thoroughfare Zone. Commercial uses along major corridors.

DMU-N.description: Dougherty Mixed Use North Zone. Mixed-use with residential and commercial.

DMU-S.description: Dougherty Mixed Use South Zone. Mixed-use with residential and commercial.

GC.description: General Commercial Zone. General retail and commercial uses.

M-1.description: Light Industrial Zone. Light manufacturing and industrial uses.

M-2.description: General Industrial Zone. General manufacturing and industrial uses.

MC.description: Medical Center Zone. Medical offices, hospitals, and health care facilities.

MUR.description: Mixed Use Residential Zone. Mixed-use with residential emphasis.

MUX.description: Mixed Use Flex Zone. Flexible mixed-use with residential and commercial.

OA.description: Office Administrative Zone. Office and administrative uses.

OL.description: Office Limited Zone. Limited office and professional uses.

OS-1.description: Open Space 1 Zone. Parks, recreation, and open space.

OS-2.description: Open Space 2 Zone. Resource conservation and open space preservation.

P.description: Public/Semi-Public Zone. Government, schools, and institutional uses.

PD.description: Planned Development Zone. Density per approved development plan.

PS.description: Public/Semi-Public Zone. Government buildings and public facilities.

RC.description: Recreation Commercial Zone. Recreation-oriented commercial uses.

RE-A.description: Rural Estate A Zone. Large-lot rural residential. Up to 0.5 du/ac.

RE-B.description: Rural Estate B Zone. Rural residential on moderate lots. Up to 1.0 du/ac.

RS-6.description: Single Family Residential, 6,000 sq ft lot. 3-6 du/ac.

RS-7.description: Single Family Residential, 7,000 sq ft lot. 3-6 du/ac.

RS-10.description: Single Family Residential, 10,000 sq ft lot. 2-4.4 du/ac.

RS-12.description: Single Family Residential, 12,000 sq ft lot. 1.5-3.6 du/ac.

RS-D.description: Single Family Residential Detached Zone. Standard single-family. 3-6 du/ac.
